description: Full-text search across every page on momenticmarketing.com (blog posts, research, the Google update tracker, case studies, Content Academy guides, Atlas, team pages). Returns up to 10 pages ranked by relevance, each with its URL, title, content type, published date, author and the passage that best matches the query. Read a full page with get_page.

format.description: Optional: json returns structured results (url, title, type, date, author, image, passage).

type.description: Optional: only pages of this content type.

name: search
